sample_source: This study was conducted using frozen post-mortem human brain specimens from a number of tissue collections facilitated by the Brainspan and psychENCODE consortia
age: one year post conception to 42 years
Single shot, label-free protein quantifications (LFQs) were obtained from the seven brain regions of 16 individuals spanning one year post conception to 42 years.
sex: Developmental samples spanned the period from early infancy (1 year post conception) to adulthood (42 years), and were derived from a near equal mix of male and female donors
